title: Artist Tec1n Interview: A 3D Artist Discovered by SM Entertainment, Taking You into His Creative World!
description:
Artist Jinbeom Park (tec1n), known for his unique visual style and unconventional creative approach, has collaborated with top brands in the fashion, entertainment, and digital art sectors. At the core of all this is Marvelous Designer.

In this interview, he will share how he uses 3D clothing as a canvas for self-expression, creating immersive virtual worlds.

Let's take a look at how this artist transforms digital fabrics into a powerful form of self-expression and carves out his own space in the creative field.
